subject: QBR agenda: product milestones, delivery tempo & risk triage
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: QBR agenda: product milestones, delivery tempo & risk triage

Team —

QBR is in two weeks. For the leadership packet I want a tight, operational view we can run in 10 minutes: where we are on the product milestones we committed to, the credible launch timelines for the next two releases, and the top delivery risks + mitigations.

Ask (please):
- One slide (PDF or 3 bullets) covering milestone status and a single ETA per milestone.
- A one-paragraph risk summary (why this is risky, likelihood, impact, mitigation owner).
- Flag any cross-org blockers (infra, legal, procurement).

I've attached a draft timeline (QBR_timeline_v4.xlsx) with my suggested roll-up. Please update your rows by EOD Tuesday.

I'll consolidate into the leadership deck on Wednesday morning. If anything is likely to move >1 week, call it out so we can re-baseline.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: QBR_timeline_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Tara O'Neill <tara@helixsys.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR agenda: product milestones, delivery tempo & risk triage

Aditya —

Quick status from Product:
- Embeddings API V2 (customer-facing): on track for 2027-03-18. Minor docs polish remaining; dependency: infra config for streaming (infra estimate: 3 days).
- Multi-turn Reranker: delayed ~8 business days due to evaluation flakiness on long contexts. Working with ML to tighten evaluation harness.
- Model catalog UX: MVP slated to ship 2027-04-01; blocked by analytics event schema change (analytics team ETA next Tue).

Top risk (short):
- Reranker evaluation flakiness — likelihood: medium, impact: high. Mitigation: carve out 3 engineer-days for targeted evaluation tests; can reduce drift window by 50%. Owner: laura_bennett.

I'll drop a 1-slide PDF into the drive and update my row in your timeline. Looping Tara (Helix) for a brief note on the integration cadence — their cutover can affect our March rollout.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 13:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR agenda: product milestones, delivery tempo & risk triage

Thanks — engineering notes / gating checklist:

1) GPU capacity and scheduling
- Risk: demand spike during staged rollout could push queue latency up ~30%. Likelihood: medium.
- Mitigation: reserve burst pool on Dedicated for first 72 hours of rollouts; we need sign-off on cost (Marcus).

2) Quantization QA for V2 models
- Risk: edge-case tokenization bugs when using int4 paths. Likelihood: low-medium, impact: medium.
- Mitigation: expand test matrix and add a smoke job to CI that runs nightly; estimate 5 engineer-days. See attached eng_gating_RNs.pdf for test plan.

3) API contract stability
- Risk: downstream clients expect stable error codes; breaking changes would require patch rollouts.
- Mitigation: implement strict compatibility checks in preflight and publish a compatibility matrix in the release notes.

Priority asks from Product: confirm which milestones are "must-ship" for this QBR vs next. If needed we can defer catalog UX to reduce risk to Embeddings V2.

Karthik Iyer
SVP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: eng_gating_RNs.pdf (document)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Reed <alex@novahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR agenda: product milestones, delivery tempo & risk triage

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick decisions:
- Approve reserve burst pool for the 72-hour rollout window. Finance will track delta to commit.
- Prioritization: Embeddings API V2 = must-ship; Catalog UX => move to next quarter unless analytics completes schema change by EOD Tue.

Action items:
- Karthik: finalize the CI smoke job and post details to INF-2412 by Wed EOD.
- Laura: update timeline and send the 1-slide PDF by Tuesday 18:00 PST.
- Aditya: consolidate and share leadership deck draft Wednesday AM.

Alex — looping you for procurement visibility on burst pool billing and any potential PO timeline impact.

Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
